title: Console: edit an SSO provider and manage its IdP group mappings from Setup (console halves of #32085)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Parent: #32085 (SSO provider lifecycle, p1). Its triage (6762077967) splits the work: the server halves stay on #32085 (seat `domain:server#2`, claim 6766299848), and the console halves come here, filed by that seat at claim.

## What is missing in the console

Found in the live Okta run for objectstack-ai/cloud#3666 (see #32085 for the full measurement):

1. **No edit form for a provider.** Setup → SSO Providers offers no way to change a SAML provider's IdP signing certificate, SSO URL or entity id, or an OIDC provider's client id/secret, issuer or scopes. #32085 adds the server door, as declared actions on `sys_sso_provider` that post `/api/v1/auth/sso/update-provider`. If the declared action's generic form renders these fields well (a write-only secret, a multi-line certificate), this card is only a live check of that form. If it does not, this card owns a purpose-built edit form.
2. **No form for IdP group mappings.** Setup → IdP Group Mappings is a read-only "System-managed" list. The only writer is `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/scim/set-group-mapping`, which no SDK method builds. Expected: a Setup form that adds or removes a group → permission-set mapping for a provider.

## Dependency

Item 1 waits on the edit door from #32085 (its second PR). Item 2 can start now. Card #32121 (seat 2, running) adds a "matches no current group" reading to `sys_idp_group_mapping` that this form can show.

## Reader

UI triage first touch: `apps/console` / objectui Setup surfaces.
